name: Call a connector
description: Reads from or acts in an external system. A read is called directly; anything else is a command and goes through the policy.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Which connector to call

fields.name: operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: Which of its operations

fields.name: arg
fields.label: Arguments
fields.description: One field per argument of the operation. A name with a dot gives one part of an argument that holds several: fields.stage is the stage among the fields

fields.name: arguments
fields.label: All arguments at once
fields.description: Instead of separate arguments: an expression giving an object, e.g. a command an agent proposed

fields.name: resultVariable
fields.label: Store the result as
fields.description: Name of the variable that receives the answer

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Why it is asked for
fields.description: Shown to whoever has to approve it: what it is for and what depends on it

name: Ask an agent
description: Asks an agent what to do. The agent decides and proposes; nothing it proposes is carried out by this step.

fields.name: agent
fields.label: Agent
fields.description: Which agent profile

fields.name: input
fields.label: What the agent is told
fields.description: One field per thing the agent should know

fields.name: table
fields.label: Fill in the calculation
fields.description: A calculation whose given lines the agent finds in what it reads, one value for each line and each year the case reports, each with the words and page it is on; the values come back by line and year in decision.claimed, ready for that calculation

fields.name: resultVariable
fields.label: Store the decision as
fields.description: Default: decision

name: Agent handles the case
description: An agent handles the case towards a goal, move by move: it reads, acts, waits for news, asks an employee, writes back, until the agent that checks confirms the goal against what the connected systems show. When a limit is reached, the case goes to a person with everything the agent did and why.

fields.name: agent
fields.label: Agent
fields.description: Who handles the case; what it may read and do comes from its profile

fields.name: goal
fields.label: Goal
fields.description: What is to be true at the end, with places for values like any text

fields.name: checker
fields.label: Who confirms it is reached
fields.description: The agent that confirms the goal against what the connected systems show; the case closes only then

fields.name: mayWait
fields.label: May wait for news or a time
fields.description: true: it may wait, for news about the case or for a time

fields.name: waitHours
fields.label: Longest wait, in hours
fields.description: Default: 24

fields.name: mayAsk
fields.label: May ask an employee
fields.description: true: it may ask a question; the question goes to the Inbox and the case waits for the answer

fields.name: askRole
fields.label: Whom it asks
fields.description: A role of People; empty: anybody

fields.name: mayWrite
fields.label: May write back
fields.description: true: it may write to whoever the case is about, through the channel the case came by

fields.name: mayRemember
fields.label: May remember for later cases
fields.description: true: it may remember something about the subject for later cases

fields.name: within
fields.label: Finish within
fields.description: A duration such as P3D (3 days) or PT12H (12 hours); empty: no time limit

fields.name: maxMoves
fields.label: At most so many moves
fields.description: Empty: no limit

fields.name: spendLimit
fields.label: AI spend for one case at most
fields.description: Dollars; empty: no limit

fields.name: blocks
fields.label: Blocks to reach the goal with
fields.description: The goal as facts and the blocks the workflow is built of, each with what it needs, what it gives, its moves and the questions that say how it ended: the way to the goal is found from the facts, and found again after every block; the agent only answers the questions and fills in the moves

fields.name: plan
fields.label: Plans first
fields.description: true: the agent's first move is a plan of numbered steps, which the checker reads; it then follows the plan, makes a new one only when news contradicts it, and the goal is reached only with every step done

fields.name: order
fields.label: The order of moves
fields.description: One rule a line, such as “task.create after WRITE and NEWS”: a move that comes earlier is not made. Moves: WRITE, ASK, WAIT, REMEMBER, DONE, ACTION or an action by its operation; after them also NEWS and ANSWER

fields.name: input
fields.label: What else the agent is told
fields.description: One field per thing the agent should know besides what opened the case

name: Wait for an event
description: Waits until an event of a type about a subject arrives. Put a boundary timer on it for a deadline.

fields.name: eventType
fields.label: Event type
fields.description: Type of the awaited event; several with commas between them, or * for anything about the subject

fields.name: subjectId
fields.label: About
fields.description: Id of the subject the event must be about

fields.name: subjectType
fields.label: Subject type
fields.description: Leave empty to accept any

name: Hand over to a person
description: Marks the case escalated; it stays on the operators' list until someone takes it.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Shown to the operator

name: Write a text
description: Writes a letter, a message or a title from a template and what the case knows. {{name}} puts a value in; {{#name}}...{{/name}} keeps a part only when there is such a value.

fields.name: template
fields.label: One of the texts
fields.description: A text kept once and used by every workflow that names it

fields.name: text
fields.label: Or a text of this step alone
fields.description: With places for values in double braces

fields.name: instead
fields.label: Use this text instead, when there is one
fields.description: E.g. a text of their own somebody keeps in another system

fields.name: html
fields.label: The text is HTML
fields.description: true: the text is an HTML letter or page, and the values put in are written so that they cannot break it

fields.name: resultVariable
fields.label: Store the text as
fields.description: Name of the variable that receives it

name: Turn a call into text
description: Turns the recording of a call into text, by a transcription of the library (which models, in which order), or takes the text a recorder made as it is.

fields.name: transcription
fields.label: How it is turned into text
fields.description: One of the transcriptions kept under Transcription

fields.name: recording
fields.label: The recording
fields.description: What a connection gave for the recording of the call, such as what “Take the recording of a meeting” read

fields.name: transcript
fields.label: Or the text a recorder made
fields.description: When a recorder already gives the text of the call, it is taken as it is

fields.name: participants
fields.label: Who was on the call
fields.description: Their names, so that the text says who speaks

fields.name: words
fields.label: Words to know
fields.description: Names and words the call may contain, to spell them right

fields.name: resultVariable
fields.label: Store the text as
fields.description: Default: call

name: Decide by rules
description: Asks a table of rules and stores what its first matching rule says. No rule matching gives an empty answer.

fields.name: rules
fields.label: Rules
fields.description: Which table of rules to ask; several with commas between them are asked in turn until one answers

fields.name: resultVariable
fields.label: Store the answer as
fields.description: Default: decision

name: Work out by a calculation
description: Works numbers out by the formulas of a calculation under Rules, line by line: no AI, nothing paid. Every line is kept with the formula and the values it came from. A person may check the values first, as an action waiting for approval.

fields.name: calculation
fields.label: Calculation
fields.description: Which calculation to work out; or a value of the case that names one, so that rules choose

fields.name: in
fields.label: What it is given
fields.description: One field per line the calculation is given, such as in.revenue; a line with a value per column takes a list of numbers or a number for each column

fields.name: resultVariable
fields.label: Keep the lines as
fields.description: Default: calculation. Later steps name a line so: calculation.value, and a column of a line by columns so: calculation.revenue.2026

fields.name: check
fields.label: A person checks the values first
fields.description: person: the values go to the Inbox before they are worked out; the person may change any, saying why

fields.name: reason
fields.label: What the person is told
fields.description: Shown with the values to check: what they are for and what to look at

fields.name: title
fields.label: Heading of the Excel file
fields.description: Such as the name of whom it is about; default: the calculation's name

name: Remember about the subject
description: Keeps something about what the case is about beyond the case itself, so that a later case can tell what was already done. Read back with ${memory.of(execution, 'key')}.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Remember as
fields.description: The name it is found by later

fields.name: value
fields.label: What to remember
fields.description: A text or a value of the case

name: Say how it ended
description: Names what the case closes as and why, in the case's history.

fields.name: outcome
fields.label: It ends as
fields.description: E.g. SKIPPED when there was nothing to do

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Why
fields.description: Shown in the case's history

name: Approval by a person
description: Where the process waits while a command needs a person's decision. Completes with variable approved.
